fail_closed_rules: Never overwrite a predecessor evidence record.
A restore transition requires a digest-bound fixity result; a planned restore is not execution evidence.
A correction must have a distinct successor digest and an append-only notification record.
A withdrawal may only reconcile declared targets and must preserve the withdrawn predecessor.
Missing, conflicting, expired or unverified target receipts keep the state below verified.
This contract does not assert hosted provider acceptance, disaster-recovery qualification, elapsed soak or release authority.
non_claims: No provider upload, restore, backup, Zenodo deposition or Hugging Face acceptance is performed by this contract.
Agent-panel assessment cannot substitute for factual external operator or external-user evidence.
Network, timetable, facility, national, clinical, dispatch and authoritative claims remain disabled.
